case_freeze.source: EXP-15 2026-09-30 frozen benchmark; no EXP-15 fixture changes
case_freeze.arm_a_definition: User-directed current memory: EXP-15 file-backed memory recall (the memory-enabled arm in the original EXP-15 comparison).
case_freeze.note: Original EXP-15 no-memory Mode A was not re-run or relabeled as this task's A arm.

measurement_scope.b_short_term_compaction: Serialization-only proxy over current memory records: concise symbolic board retains full summaries, item IDs, and file/line refs. No frozen raw tool logs exist, so no claim is made about long-log compression or task success.
measurement_scope.c_progressive_recall: Ephemeral L2 topic/scenario card preserves exact decision/constraint text, provenance refs, and L1 item IDs; optional details require one batched L1 pointer lookup. No persistent index was created.
measurement_scope.token_estimate: ceil(UTF-8 bytes / 4); deterministic approximation, not model-tokenizer measurement.
measurement_scope.source_validation: Shared evaluator read-only validation checks every referenced path and line-anchor range; it does not semantically re-adjudicate cited text.

A.implementation_complexity: None beyond the existing EXP-15 file-backed memory lookup.

B.implementation_complexity: Low: one transient deterministic renderer; no persistent state or dependency.

C.implementation_complexity: Low-medium: transient scoped scenario index plus L1 pointer resolver; one optional extra lookup for full item details.

provenance_validation.scope_note: Line-range and path checks only; source text was not semantically re-adjudicated.
